why: The estate-wide critical-function spine. A function is listed here when the estate cannot work without it. The spine (platform/estate/libexec/critical-watch.py) measures each one's LIVENESS (is it running?) and, where one exists, its GOAL (is it doing its job?). A function that is alive but missing its goal is FAILING -- that is the failure the 2026-10-28 disk watcher was: alive, ticking, and freeing nothing. The registry is data, not code: adding a function is a file edit, and the detector is the one implementation that reads it.

probe_types.heartbeat_file: a JSON file whose `at` field must be younger than max_age_s
probe_types.unix_socket: a unix socket that must accept a connection
probe_types.tcp: a TCP port that must accept a connection
probe_types.http: an HTTP GET that must answer with expect_status (default 200)
probe_types.launchd: a launchd label that must be loaded and running
probe_types.command: an argv that must exit with expect_rc (default 0)

goal_types.free_space_mb: free space on a volume must be at least min_mb
goal_types.heartbeat_field_min: a numeric field in a heartbeat JSON must be at least min

functions.title: the disk reclaim guardian
functions.why_it_is_critical: the executor refuses to start a job when the data volume has less than MIN_FREE_MB (1500MB) free, so under the floor every agent's door is closed and the estate stops

remediation.task: The estate's disk reclaim guardian (ai.estate.disk-watch) is not healthy. The evidence is in ~/.estate/incidents/latest.json: read it, then make the volume healthy again WITHOUT deleting another agent's work, another agent's dirty or claimed worktree, the founder's running Chrome, or any live tooling. The cleaner is ~/.estate/libexec/disk-cleanup.sh: run it in incremental mode with DISK_CLEANUP_TARGET_MB=2500, one bounded step at a time. If the guardian process is not loaded, load it: launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.estate.disk-watch.plist. Report what you measured, not what you intended.

functions.title: the executor daemon
functions.why_it_is_critical: every agent's tool calls go through the executor door; without it no agent can run a command at all

remediation.task: The estate's executor daemon is not answering on ~/.estate/executor.sock. The evidence is in ~/.estate/incidents/latest.json. Find why (launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/ai.estate.executor, the daemon log, the disk floor in mcp/plugins/estate_executor.py) and bring it back without losing anyone else's queued work.

functions.title: the estate event bus
functions.why_it_is_critical: state is streamed over this bus; without it the estate's surfaces go stale and agents cannot be told what happened

remediation.task: The estate's event bus (NATS) is not accepting connections on 127.0.0.1:4222. The evidence is in ~/.estate/incidents/latest.json. Check launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/ai.estate.nats and the bus logs, and bring it back.
